content: Melvin-Koushki notes for comparison that Ibn Turka's nephew Afżal al-Dīn translated Shahrastānī's K. al-Milal wa-l-Niḥal as the Tanqīḥ al-Adilla wa-l-ʿIlal, expanding it with detailed arguments disproving the doctrines of all non-Sunni groups.
refers_to_primary: Afżal al-Dīn Turka, Tanqīḥ al-Adilla wa-l-ʿIlal (per MK fn.154)
